units.source_text: 事实上，多亏下了雪，立体的金阁才变成与世无争的平面的金阁。

en.t: In fact, thanks to the snowfall, the three-dimensional Golden Pavilion had become a flat Golden Pavilion, detached from the world.
The Golden Pavilion in a painting.

units.source_text: 两岸红叶山上的枯枝几乎控不住雪花，那林子显得比往常更加光秃。

en.t: On the maple-covered hills on both banks, the bare branches could hardly hold the snowflakes, and the woods looked even barer than usual.

units.source_text: 远近的松树的积雪却蔚为壮观。

en.t: Yet the snow piled on the pine trees near and far made a magnificent sight.

units.source_text: 池子里的冰面上积雪更多了。

en.t: There was even more snow on the frozen surface of the pond.

units.source_text: 奇怪的是，个别地方却不积雪。

en.t: Strangely, however, snow had not accumulated in certain places.

units.source_text: 这些疏疏落落的大白斑点，恍如大胆描绘的装饰画上的云。

en.t: These scattered large white patches looked like clouds boldly painted on a decorative picture.

units.source_text: 看起来九山八海石和淡路岛都与他子冰面上的雪联结起来，

en.t: It looked as though the Nine Mountains and Eight Seas stone and Awaji Island were both joined to the snow on the pond's icy surface,

units.source_text: 繁茂生长在其间的小松树，像偶然从冰和雪原的中央冒了出来似的。

en.t: and the small pines growing thickly among them seemed to have emerged by chance from the middle of the ice and snowfield.
